meta.purpose: Catalog of project specialities the customer picks in onboarding step 2. Each speciality maps to an OpenHands harness + a knowledge subset (workspace files + pgvector RAG tags), pre-sets the sovereign toggle (step 6), and seeds the cost-estimation prompt (#3).
meta.grounded_in: {{CONSULTANT_NAME}} core capabilities + broadened general software/infra tracks for lower-budget clients.
owner_todo: Confirm/adjust harness ids to match the actual OpenHands configs.
Confirm knowledge_tags map to real corpora/paths inside the local /knowledge KB (workspace file sets) and pgvector RAG collections.
Set estimation numbers per complexity_baseline (credit anchors) once the token price table + markup are fixed.
Decide which 'coming_soon' specialities to enable for the alpha.

field_reference.sovereign_default: Pre-sets the onboarding sovereign/non-sovereign toggle; customer can still override.
field_reference.requires_existing_repo: If true, this speciality acts on customer-provided repo(s) rather than scaffolding from scratch.
field_reference.deliverable_type: deployed_demo = builds + deploys a live demo on a subdomain; audit_report / architecture_docs = produces documents (no running demo).
field_reference.harness: OpenHands configuration/agent profile id used for this track.
field_reference.knowledge_tags: Selects which workspace file sets + pgvector RAG collections to load into the agent context. 'ocpa' and 'cve' are implied for all build tracks.
field_reference.complexity_baseline: Rough anchor for the pre-project cost estimate (low|medium|high).
field_reference.base_fee_credits: One-time engagement fee for this track, configured per instance. It rides the evaluation estimate so it is charged with the funding; per-token usage is metered on top. 0 disables it.

specialities.label: Web / SaaS / Platform MVP - Cloud-agnostic
specialities.description: Fast, lower-cost MVP for a web app, SaaS product, or internal tool. Cloud-agnostic Docker Compose (OCPA), deployable anywhere later. The default track for quick delivery on a budget.

specialities.label: Software & Infrastructure - Sovereign EU
specialities.description: Software and infrastructure targeting sovereign, government-certified EU platforms with data residency and compliance in mind.

specialities.label: Software & Infrastructure - Sovereign CA
specialities.description: Software and infrastructure targeting sovereign, government-certified CA platforms (PIPEDA, Protected B, Loi 25) with data residency and compliance in mind.

specialities.label: Secure Infrastructure & DevSecOps
specialities.description: Build hardened, compliant systems with rigorous security practices and certified pipelines. Overlays any target platform with security-first delivery.
capabilities: Secure software development lifecycle (threat modelling, SAST/DAST, SBOM)
Security accreditation support (national and international standards)
Infrastructure as Code for reproducible deployments
